responsibility: This header declares the public API for Fortran front-end dependency analysis. It defines the dependency-check mode enum and exposes helpers for array-reference temporariness, full-array detection, intrinsic-argument selection, function-call and expression dependency checks, expression comparison shortcuts, and low-level dependency resolution used by scalarization and assignment lowering.
same_name_distinction: Defines the dependency-analysis interface and its public mode enum for callers such as scalarization and lowering code. Unlike gcc/fortran/dependency.cc, it is only the API surface for dependency checks, not their implementation.
